run_dedup_all_pairs: run dedup_all.py to deduplicate all language pair training data from a source folder to a destination folder
run_dedup_specific_directions: run dedup_all.py with specific language directions like en-de,fr-es to deduplicate selected pairs
run_dedup_auto_discover: run dedup_all.py without directions to auto-discover and deduplicate all training pairs in the folder
review_deup_function: review the deup function call that deduplicates source and target parallel corpus files
review_main_argparse: review the main function argparse setup for from-folder, to-folder, and directions arguments
